notes.title: August 1st Update
notes.notes: Optimize the Program and Some Materials

notes.title: "In-depth Investigation" Function Update
notes.notes:
After the launch of CaseCracker, Detective Wang Xun has been secretly investigating related incidents involved in the system. Now he has integrated the investigation results into the system, go to the case database interface to check this new function.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41164201/2c6f1b04801a49ce7dd0c99ebd3a8236320253c6.png[/img]

When a related clue is found, the in-depth investigation interface will display relevant titles.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41164201/758656bd806f86b81d319c2906932b5487246e5c.png[/img]

Once all the related clues have been found and a certain progress has been made, you can view Wang Xun's investigation results in the in-depth investigation.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41164201/fe02adb93bf147dcf45cd0ffbc5112c94319efc7.png[/img]

These investigation results are often related to the underlying plot.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41164201/e4434580d2239f78875db06dd0d4e467ae311f92.png[/img]

notes.title: Update-2.27
notes.notes:
Hello, testers! 

CaseCracker today has made the following two functional updates:

1. In the new version, the Police Records can be viewed not only by manually dragging the Clues to the frame but also by manually clicking on the Clues. Saves some repetitive manual dragging and dropping.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41164201/a379be2005c7aa9b4575fd2e77b909efc53ec20a.gif[/img]

2. The Hint in the new version is changed to In most cases, click the Hint button, and the option "Show answer" will appear.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41164201/e90521d758305ff4b489bba660f1b4b85cdd43c4.png[/img]

Have fun~

notes.title: CaseCracker's Full Version Released!
notes.notes:
[h3]Dear all great detectives! [/h3]

The full version of CaseCracker is already released! There is [b]a 20% off discount, only $7.92 after the deal![/b] The full version fully supports English and throws players into a seemingly peaceful, but dangerous game world.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41164201/92eb4eb4b3234b1d7ff7e1b6d9e3279a3426f572.png[/img]

Since CaseCracker’s EA was released, we've felt the enthusiasm and love for the game, for which we are very grateful! We have also taken many players' suggestions and optimized the game step by step to the full version.

The English version has a combination of puzzle ideas with English culture. Don't miss it if you like word-puzzle games!

[h3]If you have more questions, join the CaseCracker [url=https://discord.gg/qV3vRw7kHV]Discord [/url]group now! We'll do our best to help you! :)[/h3]

notes.title: The full version of CaseCracker will be delayed
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41164201/dd47397f05610114f824ca804c69def1b1020ae6.png[/img]

Dear testers! Due to some temporary technical problems with the English text of [i]CaseCracker[/i], the game text needs more time to be optimized and adjusted. Black Robe Company is dealing with it urgently. We have decided to postpone the launch of the full version of [i]CaseCracker[/i] from December 15th to [h3][b]next Monday, December 19th.[/b][/h3]

Sorry for the inconvenience. See you next Monday!

If you have more questions, welcome to join the official Discord group of CaseCracker: [url=https://discord.gg/qV3vRw7kHV]Click Here![/url]
